note: An oblate Roche equipotential using Monnier et al. (2012) CHARA/MIRC concordance-model equatorial and polar radii, 2.726 and 2.418 solar radii. Latitude shading qualitatively illustrates gravity darkening (polar temperature 10,070 K, exponent 0.231); it is not an observed surface map or calibrated color photometry. The oblique inspection view deliberately exposes flattening. From Earth Vega is seen nearly pole-on (~6.2°), so this is not its sky orientation. Earlier Aufdenberg et al. (2006) modeling supports rapid rotation but gives different parameters.
author: Universe Scales
